title: Goldeye Lake Mountain Resort

services.name: Log Cabin
services.desc: Bunk cabin accommodations offer a simple, authentic group stay experience, ideal for school groups, sports teams, youth organizations, and large gatherings. Cabins typically sleep up to 20 guests and may be booked individually or in multiples depending on group size. For larger capacity needs, Hay Cabin accommodates up to 32 guests and includes shared common areas. All cabins feature shared washroom access, with guests using a modern central washhouse with toilets, sinks, and private shower stalls.
